title: About
text: Hello! My name is CHrista Ingabire and I am an MDS student. I’m from Kigali, Rwanda and I’ve also spent 8 years in the U.S. I’m excited to be in Vancouver- It’s very beautiful and there is beautiful nature. The people here are also lovely.
